operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, with traffic growth of {{traffic_growth@FY2024}} below the {{traffic_growth@FY2023}} of FY2023.

Aeronautical revenue per passenger increased by {{aero_revenue_per_passenger.change@FY2024}} to {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}}, with the CNMC setting the maximum adjusted annual revenue per passenger for 2025 at the same level as the prior year.
The concession of the Rafael Núñez International Airport in Cartagena ended during the year, and the result includes the profit on the sale of ADI's stake in ESSP SAS.

peer_positioning.text: Aena has the highest EBITDA margin of the airport peers ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}), at {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} against a median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2024}}, and leads the group on FFO to debt ({{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}}) and FCF to debt ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}}).
Leverage sits in the middle of the group, with net leverage ranking {{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}} and gross leverage {{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}.
Cash liquidity to revenue is the weakest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

snapshot.text: Aena, the Spanish airport operator, had a stronger FY2024 as revenue rose by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}} and both Fitch and Moody's moved its ratings in a positive direction.
Net leverage fell by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}}, with the EBITDA margin widening by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}.

The point to watch is cash liquidity, which fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} of revenue, the weakest of the airport peers ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, the weakest of the airport peers ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}), as cash and cash-like investments declined by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}.
Coverage: interest coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}, so the buffer over debt service narrowed even as debt was repaid.
Traffic: traffic growth slowed by {{traffic_growth.change@FY2024}} to {{traffic_growth@FY2024}}, which limits the scope for further operating leverage.

Regulation: the CNMC set the maximum adjusted annual revenue per passenger for 2025 at the same level as the prior year, so aeronautical revenue per passenger of {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}} depends on traffic rather than tariffs.
